messages:
Maria Chen: Quick question — when the rate limiter trips and we autofallback to a lower-cost model, should the console surface the estimated cost delta and the reason code in the rollout card?
Jon Patel: yes, we should. Right now the rollout UI only shows "fallback: enabled". Users keep asking why latency dropped but errors still show.
Lee Kim: Agree. Also we should indicate whether it was a rate-based trigger vs an error-based trigger. Two different operator actions.
Maria Chen: Proposed minimal sketch: show a small badge + tooltip 'Fallback reason: RATE_LIMIT(95% window) -> est -32% cost'. Click -> timeline of events.
Priya Rao: Can we also include an example request sample that caused fallback? Like a sampled request payload linked to the audit entry. Helps SREs reproduce.
Jon Patel: +1. Implementation-wise, add a new telemetry label fallback.reason and fallback.variant, and include a link to audit/trace id. UI shows link only if trace exists.
Lee Kim: Thinking about permissions — audit link should obey data retention and PII rules. If payload is redacted we show "sample truncated".
Maria Chen: UX question: should we show a toggle to "auto-apply fallback" per-rollout or keep it global? Ops wants per-rollout control.
Priya Rao: Ops will want a soft-mode: show preview + dry-run where fallback is simulated but not executed. That way product can evaluate quality regressions.
Jon Patel: +dry-run is doable. Backend: we need an annotation in policy JSON. Example we discussed:
```json
{
  "policy": "auto_fallback",
  "triggers": ["error_5xx","rate_limit"],
  "mode": "soft_dry_run",
  "sampling_pct": 10
}
```
Lee Kim: We also need TTL for the fallback decision (how long to keep routing to fallback) and hysteresis to avoid oscillation. Suggest default 30s with exponential backoff.
Maria Chen: UI should show the TTL and allow operators to override per incident (with audit note). Must create an audit entry that includes actor, before/after config, and reason.
ops-bot: [system] autofallback.triggered fallback.variant=gpt-lite reason=RATE_LIMIT window_ms=60000 trace_id=tr_8a7b1c
Priya Rao: Nice. ops-bot entries like that should be linkable from the rollout timeline.
Jon Patel: One more: expose a small "why-this-fell-back" panel that shows sampled metrics (rt, error rate, capacity) + rule that matched. Minimal text, link to full trace.
Lee Kim: Implementation note: we should tag fallback events with the rollout_id and model_version to make debugging easier across rollouts.
Maria Chen: OK — I'll update the mockups: add reason badge, TTL control, dry-run toggle, and audit link. Will post images in #design later. Any objections?
Priya Rao: No objections. Can we add a note for support docs: "If you see RATE_LIMIT fallback, check configured quotas and batching settings" :memo:
Jon Patel: I'll file the infra task to add fallback.reason/fallback.variant labels and trace inclusion.
Maria Chen: Thanks — moving to action items.
